title: red and beige hotel/hare krishna
content: while living in the classic luxury hotel for the first time i saw this huge hare krishna temple inside. the lighting was so warm. it was on the first floor but reached into the second. on the second floor you'd be walking down a hallway with a balcony you could look over and see the temple. there was also a path on the second floor to the top floor of the temple so you could get inside from both floors. very luxury fancy vibe. it looked like one of those fancy spirit houses you see in east asian countries so detailed and intricate. i remember saying to my sister in the dream that i hated that place. later in the dream i hid in a box outside the temple and when i was found suddenly i was putting on this shen yun type of performance with silks and fans and there was a crowd in rows of chairs watching me, with a whole set up. anyone else ever see religious temples inside the hotel?
